name: phone_wallx
goal: Phone scanner held by the LEFT arm: left claw (holding the phone, 3x camera) moves over the parcel and holds until the phone has read the label; the harness routes the code (zone) and prompts WALLX; left arm takes the phone back to rest; WALLX picks the parcel up with the RIGHT arm and puts it into that zone; release, right arm home.
setup: Phone (scanner page open, 3x) gripped in the LEFT claw, camera facing out of the claw tip; parcel label-up in the middle of the table; arms at rest.
